The '''Hapan Rim Worlds''' was a large quadrant of ten inhabited [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] on the fringe of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]], and was intersected by three [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace lanes]].
